Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), October volume, plate for the 7th, captioned «Сергий и Вакх» and filed by Commons under Category:Icons of Serge and Bacchus. 7 October is the great-martyrs Sergius and Bacchus, the pair the folder names - Sergius as companion of Bacchus - and not Sergius of Radonezh (25 September) or Sergius of Nurma, each of which has its own plate. The two are shown together because their commemoration is joint; both are named in the plate's caption. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
